text: Assumption: Lifetime is the responsibility of the client after unpacking — is this correct?
text_en: Assumption: Lifetime is the responsibility of the client after unpacking — is this correct?
norm: lifetime is the responsibility of the client after unpacking
assumption: Lifetime is the responsibility of the client after unpacking.
rationale: The payload verifies return via get(), but remains silent on internal memory management after handoff.

original.text: Annahme: Die Lebensdauer obliegt nach Entpacken dem Client — trifft das zu?
original.assumption: Die Lebensdauer obliegt nach Entpacken dem Client
original.rationale: Der Payload belegt die Rückgabe über get(), schweigt jedoch zum internen Speichermanagement nach Übergabe.
